csv_project_name: Design for Legacy Woods Historic Campus & Heritage Center
csv_scope_of_work: The City of West Des Moines, Iowa, is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from qualified firms for professional architectural, landscape architectural, engineering, planning, and related design services for the Legacy Woods Historic Campus & Heritage Center Development Project.The selected firm s final scope of services will be negotiated after selection and may include all or a portion of the services listed below. The City reserves the right to add, remove, modify, or phase services based on project needs, available funding, City priorities, and negotiated agreement terms. Basic services are expected to include usual and customary architectural, landscape architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, cost estimating, and related professional services necessary to complete the approved scope.

project_scope: Development project for the Legacy Woods Historic Campus & Heritage Center in West Des Moines. The notice seeks a qualified team for architectural, landscape architectural, engineering, planning, and related design services. The final scope will be negotiated and may be phased or modified based on funding and City priorities. services: Professional architectural, landscape architectural, engineering, planning, master planning, civil engineering, cost estimating, and related design services; basic services may include architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and cost estimating services.
relevance_explanation:
- Building/campus development project with potential structural engineering component.
- Early-stage multidisciplinary design procurement can offer strategic entry into the planning team.
- However, the notice is primarily architecture, landscape architecture, planning, and general design oriented.
- No information on large spans, complex structures, innovative materials, or architecturally demanding special structures.
- Historic campus and heritage center could involve building work, but scale and structural ambition are unclear.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender documents. fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The procurement is an RFQ for professional design services with scope to be negotiated after selection, so no reliable fee estimate can be derived from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications are requested from qualified firms for professional architectural, landscape architectural, engineering, planning, and related design services. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
